lead.headline: BUN SHIPS BUN-V1.3.14
lead.deck: GitHub has released version 1.3.14 of the Bun JavaScript runtime, available for installation via a curl command or npm package, with upgrade instructions and release notes available on the official Bun blog
lead.body: The latest update, which credits 11 contributors, brings improvements to the platform, with users able to install the new version using a simple command or package manager, and upgrade existing installations with a single command
